Originated lines · 27 October 2026 · UTC

An independent fair price for all 2393 priced selections.

We de-vig every OLBG market, blend in tip consensus and (where available) official strength data, then publish our own American price. This is a research line, not a bookmaker offer.

How to read this table: “OLBG price” is the price displayed in the captured event payload. “Our fair line” is our calculated no-margin price. “Edge pp” is our fair probability minus the de-vigged market probability, in percentage points. Every row links to an official source and the OLBG event.
